instruction: I like watching movies using VLC on my laptop. I often watch the same movie multiple times, but I have to manually restart it each time it ends. Can you enable the repeat/loop feature so videos automatically replay when they finish?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC's loop/repeat feature. The evaluator checks if the 'loop' setting in VLC configuration is set to 1 (enabled). This is similar to the original task which modifies VLC settings, but targets a different configuration option.
